Ugh, it’s kinda cold today. 
Because my country was so good at fighting global warming now we have another problem. 0 degrees is nothing unusual now, even in the middle of spring.
On the brighter side it’s at least not as bad as in Europe. It’s kinda ironic, now immigrants are going south, not north. 
The radiator isn’t even hot... Fuck!
Mr. Landlord should stop saving on heating up the building. This greedy guy will do anything to keep his coin in a pocket. 
I swear he has no redeeming qualities. A fucking boomer bully.
Wasn’t he telling me about his daughter or something? She probably hates him too. 
Well, Whatever. This piece of shit needs to stop being on my mind. 
I just need to chill and get the money every week. Hopefully he will get tired of pissing me off and will stop coming everytime something happens.
